params.title: Configure Hammer grip
params.code: using UnityEditor; using UnityEngine; using Mismo.Gameplay.Player.Equipment; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var pose=AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<WeaponPoseProfile>("Assets/Data/Weapons/Hammer/HammerPose.asset"); pose.maintainSupportGrip=true; pose.supportGrip=new Vector3(0,.30f,0); EditorUtility.SetDirty(pose); AssetDatabase.SaveAssets(); result.Log("Hammer support grip enabled."); } }
